summary: Add a top-level keyword-roi-tiers command that buckets keywords into scale/hold/cut by ROAS.
reason: This read-only workflow composes one googleAds:search GAQL read over keyword_view, computes ROAS (conversions_value / cost) and CPA locally, and tiers each keyword. No new HTTP code; reuses the shared fetchGAQLRows helper and existing output plumbing.
